reference_R: second independent 171Yb+ E3 ion clock outside that enclosure, in a monitored separate thermal enclosure
comparison: both target transitions against R through a frequency comb and phase-stabilized optical paths; retain independent servo outputs and common-reference covariance
ordinary_source_model: same pinned GR4 electric-dipole polarizabilities; both target and reference retain thermal shifts, not zeroed by assumption

timestamps, durations, averaging/sensitivity functions and validity masks
uncorrected comparator/servo readings, nominal ratios and scaling conventions
separate ledger of every applied BBR, probe, Zeeman, Doppler, quadrupole and gravity correction
independent target and reference radiometry/spectra or effective-temperature calibration with covariance
emissivities, view factors, gradients, sensor calibration and heater-state record
reference drift and thermal cross-talk bounds; optical path/comb residuals
joint covariance, including shared reference and calibration errors

changing gravitational potential or target-reference velocity difference
ordinary unmodeled shifts common in fractional units
